st.t: Talk to Arhein on the northern part of the Catherby Docks to start the quest.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby.

If you didn't bring charcoal, take a piece from the cabinet near Councillor Catherine. Then tap the form to fill it in. Any answers work, but the audit later asks the same questions, so pick the first answer each time, as listed below.
Hand over the filled form to Councillor Catherine.
Finish talking to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby.
Talk to Arhein on the docks about the mayor.
s: I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

st.t: Talk to Harry in the fish shop in south-east Catherby about a new mayor.
Fish a new mayor from the aquarium.
Introduce Arhein on the Catherby docks to the new Mayor of Catherby.
Talk to Councillor Catherine about changing the by-laws.

Talk to Councillor Catherine to complete the audit. Give the same 8 answers you wrote on form cr-4p. If you picked the first answer each time, they're listed below. If one is wrong, she asks that question again.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby to receive a new form 7r4-5h.
Use form 7r4-5h on the Mayor of Catherby.
Show Councillor Catherine the signed form.
Give Arhein on the Catherby docks the good news.
If you don't have the Current duck, get a new one from Arhein on the Catherby docks, or from your ship's cargo hold. If you have it, skip this step.
Board your ship at the Catherby docks and sail east to the ripple just west of the Obelisk of Water, by the small island east of Catherby. Stop with your ship on top of the ripple.
With your ship on top of the ripple, tap the Current duck in your inventory to release it.
Follow the Current duck! It'll end up south-west of Entrana.
Collect your Current duck.
Share what you've learned with Arhein on the Catherby docks.
